about: The Pajek specimen pages: each sheet file drawn by Pajek 6.02 under its defaults with the Draw window 1200 x 900, plus the ini options a page names (a flag option is written as its name alone). names: vertex number -> setting id. Written by graph-io/test/fidelity/generators/specimens/pajek.py.

notSwept.vertex.HOOKS=CART: hooks are defined per shape in SHAPES.CFG, not in the .net file; the edges-lines-p2 sheet reaches the shipped SHAPES.CFG's hooks (box CART, ellipse CIRC, cross POLAR) through h1 / h2
notSwept.ini.Form8.SizeofVertexBorder=number: Options / Size / of Vertex Border changes only the Draw window: the SVG export of a sheet drawn with it at 3 is byte for byte the default one
notSwept.ini.CenterLabels=on: Labels Centered changes only the Draw window: the labels sheet's SVG export with it is byte for byte the default one
notSwept.ini.LabelswithTransparentBackGround1=on: changes only the Draw window: the labels sheet's SVG export with it is byte for byte the default one (the SVG never draws a label background)
notSwept.ini.Form8.SizeofFont=number: changes only the Draw window: the labels sheet's SVG export at 16 is byte for byte the default one
notSwept.ini.Form8.SizeofLines=number: changes only the Draw window: the edges-lines sheet's SVG export at 3 is byte for byte the default one
notSwept.ini.Arrowsinthemiddle1=on: changes only the Draw window: the arrows sheet's SVG export with it is byte for byte the default one (an arc's own ap moves its arrow)
notSwept.ini.Form8.SizeofArrows=number: changes only the Draw window: the arrows sheet's SVG export at 14 is byte for byte the default one
notSwept.ini.Form8.withValues1=on: not reached: with Form8.withValues1 in the ini (the flag as SAVEINI names it) the edge-labels sheet's SVG export draws no line values, byte for byte the default one; the option may need the Draw window's menu, which the headless route cannot click
